other_conditions: The unit must have its operations located in Goa.
The applicant must be a legally recognised entity such as a Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership.
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partner(s)/director(s) must be linked to Aadhaar.

The unit must incur expenditure for acquiring any of the specified quality or product certifications (e.g., ISO, HACCP, BIS, WHO‑GMP, ZED, TS, COPC, eSCM, Hallmark, or other government‑recognised certificates).
The scheme can be applied for on a quarterly, bi‑annual, or annual basis after the relevant expenditure is incurred.
Benefits are subject to budgetary allocation and may be discontinued if the allocation is exceeded.
Only one reimbursement claim is allowed per unit for the entire policy period.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to ₹5,00,000 per unit for the cost of industry‑standard quality certifications.
